name: octaweave_create_post
description: Create a blog post. It starts as a DRAFT — nothing is public until octaweave_publish_post. `body` is markdown. `cover_url` and any images in the body should be public drive URLs from octaweave_share_file.

workspace.description: Workspace slug or uuid. An API key is pinned to ONE workspace — call octaweave_whoami and use actor.workspace_id. A wrong workspace is a 403, not a 404.

excerpt.description: Optional excerpt; derived from the body when omitted.

cover_url.description: Optional cover image URL (a shared drive link).

canonical_url.description: Optional canonical URL if this is republished from elsewhere.
